moworks.notes: Target moves 0 → 1 on a spring, stiffness 80, damping 16, mass 1.6 (damping ratio 0.71): 4.3 % overshoot, within 1 % by ~930 ms. Kit form: springk(50, 10) over 0.93 s. Rule: large cards and full-screen objects; a slow landing. Small demo: the target moves 102 px beside the response graph, with overshoot and settle readouts. Params: stiffness (80) · damping (16) · mass (1.6) · duration (0.93 s). Ratio 0.71: about 4 % past and a slow landing (~0.93 s), for large cards and full-screen objects.
